cli.exit_status.0: the command completed and succeeded: its status is succeeded and any save wrote everything, or resolve, schema, --version or --help printed its output
cli.exit_status.1: the command completed with findings: a status of failed or skipped, a refused save, remaining lint findings, a failed selftest case, or a refusal that carries issues
cli.exit_status.2: the command could not run as asked: a usage error, an argument the facade cannot take, a PATH whose declared type the command does not take, or a failed write to standard output; a file problem the engine reports as an issue exits 1
